chunks.arabic_text: رَوَى إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ مُسْلِمٍ عَنْ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ آبَائِهِ عَلَيْهِمُ السَّلَامُ قَالَ

translations.en: Ismāʿīl ibn Muslim narrated from Jaʿfar ibn Muḥammad, from his father, from his forefathers, peace be upon them, who said:

chunks.arabic_text: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ لِامْرَأَةٍ سَأَلَتْهُ أَنَّ لِي زَوْجًا وَ بِهِ عَلَيَّ غِلْظَةٌ وَ إِنِّي صَنَعْتُ شَيْئًا لِأُعَطِّفَهُ عَلَيَّ

translations.en: The Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم said to a woman who had asked him: “I have a husband who is harsh toward me, and I made something to make him affectionate toward me.”

chunks.arabic_text: فَقَالَ لَهَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ أُفٍّ لَكِ كَدَّرْتِ الْبِحَارَ وَ كَدَّرْتِ الطِّينَ وَ لَعَنَتْكِ الْمَلَائِكَةُ الْأَخْيَارُ وَ مَلَائِكَةُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَ الْأَرْضِ

translations.en: So the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم said to her: “Uff to you! You have polluted the seas, corrupted the clay, and the righteous angels and the angels of the heavens and the earth have cursed you.”

chunks.arabic_text: قَالَ فَصَامَتِ الْمَرْأَةُ نَهَارَهَا وَ قَامَتْ لَيْلَهَا وَ حَلَقَتْ رَأْسَهَا وَ لَبِسَتِ الْمُسُوحَ فَبَلَغَ ذَلِكَ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ فَقَالَ إِنَّ ذَلِكَ لَا يُقْبَلُ مِنْهَا

translations.en: He said: Then the woman fasted by day, stood in worship by night, shaved her head, and wore coarse garments. When that reached the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم, he said: “Indeed, that will not be accepted from her.”

en.summary: This hadith narrates the severe condemnation of a woman who used a harmful means to influence her husband’s affection. It emphasizes the grave moral and legal seriousness of such an act, and shows that outward acts of worship alone do not make it acceptable after committing such a wrong.
en.seo_question: What does this hadith say about using magic or unlawful means to influence one’s spouse?

key_terms.غِلْظَةٌ: harshness or rough treatment from the husband
key_terms.لِأُعَطِّفَهُ: to cause him to become affectionate or inclined toward her
key_terms.الْمَلَائِكَةُ: the angels, invoked here as witnesses to the gravity of the act
key_terms.الْمُسُوحَ: coarse garments worn as a sign of austerity
